title: Two commits made on a detached HEAD have vanished
intro: A colleague checked out the tag v2.3.0 to reproduce a customer bug, fixed it in two commits, then ran 'git switch main' to pull the latest. Now the fix is nowhere: not in 'git log', not on any branch. They're sure they committed it.

steps.prompt: List all branches to confirm the commits aren't on any of them.
steps.hint: git branch -a lists local and remote branches.

steps.prompt: The commits exist; no branch points at them. Look at where HEAD has been.
steps.fake_output:
b7c8d9e HEAD@{0}: checkout: moving from 4f5a6b7c to main
4f5a6b7 HEAD@{1}: commit: Handle empty cart in tax calculation
e3d2c1b HEAD@{2}: commit: Add regression test for empty cart
7c2e0d4 HEAD@{3}: checkout: moving from main to v2.3.0
steps.hint: git reflog records every position HEAD has had, including commits no branch points to.

steps.prompt: The second fix commit is 4f5a6b7. Give it a name so it can't be lost: create the branch fix/empty-cart-tax at that commit.
Confirm both commits are on the new branch, on top of v2.3.0.
steps.fake_output:
4f5a6b7 Handle empty cart in tax calculation
e3d2c1b Add regression test for empty cart

steps.prompt: Push it so it exists somewhere other than this laptop.
steps.fake_output:
To github.com:acme/shop.git
 * [new branch]      fix/empty-cart-tax -> fix/empty-cart-tax
branch 'fix/empty-cart-tax' set up to track 'origin/fix/empty-cart-tax'.

resolution: Checking out a tag (or a commit id, or a remote branch like origin/main) puts you in 'detached HEAD' state: HEAD points straight at a commit instead of at a branch. Commits made there are real, but nothing names them, so when you switch away they become unreachable and disappear from 'git log'. Git even warned about it at the time ('you are leaving 2 commits behind'), which is easy to miss. The reflog keeps every position HEAD has held for about 90 days, so the commits were one 'git branch <name> <sha>' away from safety. Note the reflog is local only: it isn't pushed, and a fresh clone doesn't have it. Prevention: when checking out a tag to work on it, create a branch immediately ('git switch -c fix/... v2.3.0').
